name: Block Master
description: A friendly, self-hosted Bitcoin mempool and block explorer for your node: plain-language fee advice ('What fee should I pay?'), tooltips that explain blocks, fees and the mempool, and a logo that dresses up for U.S. holidays.

Block Master is an independent fork of The Mempool Open Source Project (AGPL-3.0). It is not affiliated with mempool.space. It reads from your own Bitcoin Core and Electrum server: no third-party servers.
Runs alongside myNode's built-in Mempool app (different port and data folder).

app_page_content.heading: First run
content: Block Master needs Electrs (myNode's Electrum server) for address pages. Enable Electrs and let it finish syncing.
The first start builds a local database of recent blocks and fee statistics. The dashboard fills in within a few minutes, and mining graphs take longer.

app_page_content.heading: Holiday themes
content: The logo and accent colours follow U.S. holidays automatically. Change it or turn it off with the 'Holiday theme' menu at the bottom of any page.
